New EP

Between the Fog
and the Fire

Mara Vale

Recorded over two days in a wood-heated cabin outside of Asheville, NC — no click track, no second takes. What you hear is what happened.

Six songs about leaving, staying, and the hours that don't have names yet.

Released — March 1, 2026
Format — Digital / Limited Vinyl (300 pressed)
Label — Self-Released
Recorded — Asheville, NC
